$r = (int)$parts[1];

$n = 9;
$ten = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

for ($i = 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $ten[$i] = 10 * $ten[$i - 1];
}

$luckyNumbers = [];
for ($length = 1; $length <= $n; $length++) {
    $limit = 1 << $length;
    for ($cur = 0; $cur < $limit; $cur++) {
        $value = 0;
        for ($j = 0; $j < $length; $j++) {
            if (($cur >> $j) & 1) {
                $value += $ten[$j] * 7;
            } else {
                $value += $ten[$j] * 4;
            }
        }
        $luckyNumbers[] = $value;
    }

$lastNumber = $l;
$answer = 0;

foreach ($luckyNumbers as $luckyNumber) {
    if ($luckyNumber > $r) {
        $answer += ($r - $lastNumber + 1) * $luckyNumber;
        break;
    }
    if ($luckyNumber >= $l) {
        $answer += ($luckyNumber - $lastNumber + 1) * $luckyNumber;
        $lastNumber = $luckyNumber + 1;
